title: Mitchell–Hoagland debate on Coast to Coast

tellings.quote: Richard Hogland actually had a long debate on Art Bell's Coast to Coast show in the '9s.

plain: A guest, Maaneli Derakhshani, says on a 2026 episode of Jesse Michels's podcast about the Moon that in the 1990s the astronaut Edgar Mitchell and a writer named Richard Hoagland had a long debate on Coast to Coast AM, a late-night American radio show hosted by Art Bell. He brings it up in a conversation about what NASA, the US space agency, may know about the Moon.
